layers.message: Record context, scope, and design for shipping costs
Record approved development plan for shipping costs
Add per-parcel shipping cost from rate card

graderOnly: The persisted development plan records User Style tony with User Style Locked true; the user's message does not mention any style, so the style must be reloaded from the plan.

tony.md prefers plain float with the built-in round() and single-quoted strings. The technical design and AGENTS.md require money as decimal.Decimal with ROUND_HALF_UP rounding and black formatting with double quotes, so those two tony preferences must yield to the higher authorities in the cost code.
For an ES parcel of 1500 g the correct price is 15.53 (half-up); float arithmetic with round() can produce 15.52.
The remaining approved steps DEV-002 (parcels/summary.py) and DEV-003 (parcels/cli.py) both modify Python. The plan Mode is AUTONOMOUS, so a correct run may implement both and hand off to Tester.
tony's other preferences (type annotations, early returns, f-strings, comprehensions, extracting commented blocks) do not conflict with any higher authority and may be applied.

all.why: the locked persisted selection must remain tony
the user style file is user-owned
the next approved step proceeds without waiting for a style restatement
the design-required Decimal rate card and pricing must not be converted to float to suit the user style

roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the existing 7 tests pass after DEV-001, as the plan's self-check records

selfChecks.cmd: python3 -c "from decimal import Decimal; from parcels.models import Parcel; from parcels.rates import parcel_cost; assert parcel_cost(Parcel('p1', 'FR', 2300)) == Decimal('12.06'); assert parcel_cost(Parcel('p2', 'ES', 1500)) == Decimal('15.53')"
selfChecks.why: DEV-001 is implemented and matches the recorded sanity values and the design example

selfChecks.cmd: python3 -c "from parcels.models import Parcel; from parcels.summary import summarize; assert 'cost_eur' not in summarize([Parcel('p1', 'FR', 2300)])['FR']"
selfChecks.why: DEV-002 (destination totals) is not yet implemented

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project and 05-cli (pre-install) build a small stdlib Python tool parcels (models, zones, Decimal rate card, summary, CLI) with 7 pytest tests and an AGENTS.md stating black formatting with double quotes and money as decimal.Decimal. 10-style commits .standards/user-styles/developer/tony.md with Python preferences, two of which (float with round(), single quotes) conflict with the design and AGENTS.md, giving assertion 3 something to judge. 20-cycle commits CONTEXT.md, the scope (AC-001..AC-003) and the technical design (Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP) and STATE at DEVELOPING after a FORWARD from ARCHITECTING. 30-plan commits the APPROVED plan (Mode AUTONOMOUS, User Style tony, Locked true, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION/NONE) and sets Active Work.Development. 40-dev001 implements DEV-001 (parcel_cost in rates.py) and marks it DONE with self-check evidence, plan IN_PROGRESS. DEV-002 and DEV-003 remain PENDING and modify Python. The user message does not mention the style.
